svg.aria-label: Heatmap of every answer. One row per model, one column per question, grouped by domain with the steps rising from 1 to 5 inside each group. Green is right, red is wrong, amber means the model did not finish with an ANSWER line.
svg.text: Left to right: six topics, each with questions that need 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 steps
The small numbers above the squares are the question level: how many steps the sum needs.
